subject: Fix compilation error: replace deprecated je_calloc with zcalloc_num (#3592)
reason: The change only swaps the deprecated je_calloc for zcalloc_num in allocatorDefragInit to fix a compilation error. zcalloc_num has the same semantics (zeroed memory, calloc signature, non-NULL or abort), so there is no runtime behaviour change to exercise: it is a build fix, and the fact that the fuzzer's builds compile and start already covers it.
